place.name: Baatara gorge waterfall
place.description: The Baatara gorge sinkhole (Baatara gorge waterfall) is a waterfall in the Batroun district of Lebanon near the village of Chatine in the town of Tannourine. The waterfall drops 255 metres (837 ft) into the Balaa Pothole, a cave of Jurassic limestone located on the Lebanon Mountain Trail.
